description_zh: 调用该接口分页查询驱动信息
name: QueryEdgeDriver

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中，每页显示的记录数量。最大取值30，最小取值1，默认取值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The driver type. Valid values:

0: official driver.
1: custom driver
parameters.help_zh:
驱动类型：

0：表示官方驱动。
1：表示自研驱动
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The driver name. Specify this parameter if you want to filter query results by driver name
parameters.help_zh: 驱动名称。若查询驱动信息时，需要匹配驱动名称，则填写该参数
parameters.name: driver_name

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。最小取值为1
parameters.name: current_page

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:
Success: The call was successful.
Other values: an error code was returned. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：
Success：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call was successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

CpuArch.description_en:
The CPU architecture to which the driver is adapted. Valid values:

armv7
armv7-hf
aarch64
x86-64
x86
CpuArch.description_zh:
驱动适配的CPU架构，有如下几种架构：

armv7
armv7-hf
aarch64
x86-64
x86

DriverProtocol.description_en:
The communication protocol of the driver. Valid values:

modbus: Modbus protocol.
opc-ua: OPC Unified Architecture protocol.
customize: custom protocol
DriverProtocol.description_zh:
驱动通信协议：

modbus：表示Modbus通信协议。
opc-ua：表示OPC UA通信协议。
customize：表示自定义通信协议

GmtCreateTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the driver was created

GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the driver was last updated
GmtModifiedTimestamp.description_zh: 最后一次更新驱动的Unix时间戳

IsApply.description_en: Indicates whether the driver requires an application before use. Currently, only false is supported
IsApply.description_zh: 该驱动是否需要申请才能使用。当前仅支持false值

IsBuiltIn.description_en:
Indicates whether the driver file is built-in. Valid values:

true: The driver is a built-in driver. The driver code is pre-installed on the gateway.
false: The driver is not a built-in driver
IsBuiltIn.description_zh:
驱动文件是否内置：

true：表示驱动为内置驱动，即驱动代码已预置到网关上。
false：表示驱动为非内置驱动

Runtime.description_en:
The language type of the driver. Valid values:

nodejs8: Node.js v8.
python3: Python v3.5.
c: C language
Runtime.description_zh:
驱动的语言类型，有如下三种类型：

nodejs8：表示Node.js v8。
python3：表示Python v3.5。
c: 表示C语言

Type.description_en:
The driver type. Valid values:

0: official driver.
1: custom driver
Type.description_zh:
驱动类型：

0：表示官方驱动。
1：表示自研驱动

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page
PageSize.description_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量

Total.description_en:
The total number of official drivers or custom drivers: 

If the Type request parameter is set to 0, this value indicates the total number of official drivers.
If the Type request parameter is set to 1, this value indicates the total number of custom drivers
Total.description_zh:
官方驱动或自研驱动的总数量： 

请求参数Type的值为0，则此处是官方驱动的总数量。
请求参数Type的值为1，则此处是自研驱动的总数量

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
